instruction: Create a new sheet called "Report". Merge the first row cells A1, B1, C1, and D1 to form a single cell and type "Compound Interest Report". In row 2, merge cells A2 and B2 and enter "Input Data".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new 'Report' sheet with merged cells A1:D1 containing 'Compound Interest Report' as a title, and merged cells A2:B2 containing 'Input Data' as a subtitle. Evaluator verifies the sheet exists, both merged groups have the correct text, and boundary cells (E1, C2) are NOT merged.

llm_judge_reasons: COMPLETE COVERAGE: All instruction requirements verified - sheet name 'Report', merged cells A1:D1 with value 'Compound Interest Report', merged cells A2:B2 with value 'Input Data'
CORRECT LOGIC: Getter extracts merged_range for each cell (e.g., 'A1:D1'), metric verifies all cells in a group share the same merged_range, ensuring cells are truly merged together
EXPLICIT GROUP DEFINITIONS: Expected rules now use explicit 'merged_groups' structure with cells, value, and expected_range for each group - no heuristics needed
PROPER SCORING: Metric independently checks merge status (2 points per cell: merged flag + correct range) and value (1 point for first cell), enabling sensible partial credit
BOUNDARY VERIFICATION: Non-merged cells (E1, C2) checked to ensure only intended cells are merged
STATE FRESHNESS: Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save file, ensuring xlsx file is updated before evaluation
VALUE CORRECTNESS: Expected values exactly match instruction text; expected_range values (A1:D1, A2:B2) are correct for the merged groups
